I tried to commit suicide by benadryl. I won't go into why, I just couldn't deal with the emotions of my wife being with someone else. I had been drinking and decided 'what the hell' and took a bottle (probably about 80 left). I knew they made me groggy so a lot should kill me right?
I thought I'd go to sleep and never wake up. Except I did wake up. It didn't work. I'm not sure how much later it was (I think I lost a day) but I could hardly walk, like an extremely drunk person who keeps falling down, my equilibrium was totally gone.
I had to hold onto things to get anywhere. Even falling over when on my hands and knees. It felt like bugs were crawling on me and biting me. I thought people were talking to me but when I turned to look there was nobody there. I saw someone on my couch that talked to me, but again - nobody there. My dog came and lied down by me but then disappeared. I finally started to realize that I was hallucinating and thought, great not dead but now I'm insane. Then paranoia and the anxiety of that started hitting me and I started shaking all over. The shaking lasted all day and then some.
The next day the hallucinations were gone but my equilibrium was still off. Some anxiety was still there wondering if I was permanently screwed up instead of dead. (Still concerned about kidney/liver damage) The 3rd day the equilibrium still wasn't 100% but a lot better anyway. I can't really say how long it took to come back but I felt a little off kilter for awhile.
It was kind of like being in the twilight zone where nothing makes sense. It was VERY UNPLEASANT.
